instruction: Use AutoCAD. Open only the DXF file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\user\Desktop\nozzle_seed.dxf. Import nozzle_seed.dxf. Draw a closed tapered nozzle side profile through vertices (0,20), (70,20), (130,40), (70,60), and (0,60). Add inlet circle centered at (0,40) radius 18, outlet circle centered at (130,40) radius 10, a CENTER line from (0,40) to (130,40), an inlet flange rectangle (-18,14)-(12,66), an outlet flange rectangle (118,24)-(142,56), four radius 4 HOLE bolt holes at (-8,25), (-8,55), (138,31), and (138,49), and text ACAD-30. Use OUTLINE for the tapered side profile and flange rectangles, CUTOUT for inlet and outlet circles, CENTER for the center line, HOLE for bolt holes, and ANNOTATION for text. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder. [Software] Launch AutoCAD with `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\AutoCAD 2024\acad.exe`.
